description: Runs per agent (radar, forge, recon, outreach, sentinel, amplify, social) in the window, newest first, each with startedAt, completedAt, status and triggeredBy. sinceDays sets the window (default 30); every run in it is listed, up to 300 per agent, and perAgent caps that lower. Agents with no runs in the window are left out.

perAgent.description: Runs per lane, default every run in the window (at most 300)

name: get_agent_activity
